name: JPMorgan Chase
title: 8-K · JPMORGAN CHASE & CO. EARNINGS RELEASE - SECOND QUARTER 2026 RESULTS

read.thesis: Strong Q2 with reported net income $21.2B (ROTCE 29%, 23% ex-significant items); Markets up 35% and IB fees up 30% on elevated activity, but no capacity or supply-discipline evidence in this release.

triggers.label: IB fees up 30% YoY
triggers.quote: Investment Banking fees up 30% YoY, up 14% QoQ; #1 ranking for Global Investment Banking fees

red_flags.label: Visa and equity gains flatter reported EPS
red_flags.quote: $4.6 billion net gain related to Visa shares
